purpose: Teach: マツダ/尾根/漆/覆面/胡椒/縞/大理石/洗車

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマツダ車を新調されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's just picked up a new Mazda.
lines.style: Warm observation, a little distracted. Gentle lilt at the end—sharing news that might interest him. Soft, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと山の尾根を歩きたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to walk with Dad along the mountain ridge.
lines.style: Small, earnest voice. No embellishment—just stating what he wants clearly. A little hopeful in the stillness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが漆塗りの重箱を大事にされてるわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma takes very good care of her lacquered jubako box.
lines.style: Reflective but warm. The tone of someone sharing something she thinks matters. Measured pace, respectful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、覆面プロレスラーごっこやったよ
lines.en: Mom, I played masked wrestler today.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact delivery. A tiny hint of pride underneath—he's testing her reaction. Almost wry in its simplicity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが胡椒をひいて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is grinding some pepper for us.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of a small moment. Quiet tone, as if she's noticing something tender. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、縞模様のセーター着たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to wear a striped sweater.
lines.style: Direct, simple want stated without hesitation. Warm underneath—he trusts her with what he likes. Soft, genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、大理石のテーブル、お洒落でいいわね
lines.en: Sho, that marble table does look quite lovely, doesn't it.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation, almost to herself. A thought she's sharing rather than explaining. Slight trailing-off—inviting him into the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお洗車手伝うよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to help Dad wash the car.
lines.style: Straightforward, a little brighter. Quiet pride in being useful. Quick, light pace—eager but not loud.
